visual_action: Joe Biden and Kamala Harris stand in a hallway and are asked questions by an off-screen person. They take turns answering, speaking directly to the camera and the questioner.

cast.name: Joe Biden
cast.evidence: Is on screen for the entire video and speaks about restoring Roe v. Wade and the state of the economy.

cast.name: Kamala Harris
cast.evidence: Is on screen for the entire video and speaks about reproductive freedom and administration accomplishments like capping insulin costs.

cast.name: unnamed questioner
cast.evidence: An off-screen female voice asks the questions that prompt Biden and Harris's responses.

on_screen_text.text: Excuse me, what can we do to protect reproductive freedom?
Well, we’re going to have to fight every day, understanding that it is a foundational freedom
and women should have the right to make decisions about what happens to their body
and not have their government tell them what to do.
We’re going to restore Roe v. Wade nationwide.
So what else is on the line in 2024?
A lot’s on the line. We’ve made great progress in making sure that middle class folks have a fighting chance
and poor folks have a way up. And we’re— the economy is the best in the world, literally. Inflation’s coming down.
But most of all what we’re doing is giving people hope. It’s all about giving people hope. And that’s what’s happening, I think.
Well, and under the President’s leadership, we have capped the cost of insulin for seniors at $35 a month — long overdue.
We have allowed Medicare to now negotiate drug prices. So seniors are not going to pay more than $2,000 a year for their medication.
And not to mention what, under your leadership, has happened to relieve people with student loan debt. It’s a very big deal.

spoken_summary: An off-screen person asks Joe Biden and Kamala Harris about protecting reproductive freedom and what is at stake in 2024. Harris states that reproductive freedom is a foundational right that must be fought for daily. Biden adds that they will restore Roe v. Wade nationwide. He then says the economy is the "best in the world" and that his administration is "giving people hope." Harris lists accomplishments such as capping insulin costs for seniors, allowing Medicare to negotiate drug prices, and providing student loan debt relief.
audio_music: The audio consists only of spoken dialogue in a resonant hallway. There is no music or sound effects.
editing_pacing: The video is a single, uncut, static shot filmed with a handheld camera.
central_claim: The Biden-Harris administration is fighting to restore reproductive rights and has delivered key economic and healthcare successes that are at stake in the 2024 election.
intended_effect: To persuade viewers of the administration's accomplishments and commitment to their rights, encouraging support in the upcoming election.
